presentation: 63-year-old never-smoker. Lobectomy for a 3.5 cm peripheral right upper lobe adenocarcinoma; pathology pT2aN0M0 (AJCC 9th ed. stage IB), R0. EGFR L858R present. PD-L1 TPS 30%. Good pulmonary reserve.
question: Recommend post-resection management for this stage IB tumor.
note_for_learner: Watch the staging-edition trap: PD-L1 is NOT a stage I treatment driver, and KEYNOTE-091 (IB >=4 cm) does not apply to a current-edition 3.5 cm IB tumor. Adjuvant osimertinib (ADAURA) is the evidence-based option.
